_comment: The packs the crew body build may read (openspec/changes/crew-bodies, design section 2), each pinned by SHA-256. Copied from Undercity's tools/deps/character_packs.json (RubenTipparach/fps-game-demo at 4d0dd78, 2026-10-10) with only the two packs Star Crew uses: the MPFB 2 add-on and MakeHuman's CC0 system assets. The animation pack is not used: Star Crew bakes its own clips (crew-on-deck 17). tools/blender/build_crew_bodies.py finds a pack in $STARCREW_DEPS/packs, ~/.cache/starcrew/deps/packs or Undercity's ~/.cache/undercity/deps/packs (the same files), and downloads it from its url otherwise.

packs.name: MPFB 2.0.17, the MakeHuman plugin for Blender
packs.author: The MakeHuman team
packs.licence: code GPL-3.0-or-later; its data (base mesh, targets, rigs, weights) CC0; output unclaimed
packs.licence_stated_in: https://github.com/makehumancommunity/mpfb2/blob/master/LICENSE.md, and the extension listing (SPDX GPL-3.0-or-later for the code)

packs.name: MakeHuman system assets, the CC0 pack (skins, eyes, brows, lashes, hair, proxies, clothes)
packs.author: The MakeHuman community
packs.licence_stated_in: The pack page, which lists every asset in it with the licence CC0 (the page field), and MPFB's licence page, https://github.com/makehumancommunity/mpfb2/blob/master/LICENSE.md. Its 147 asset files carry no licence lines of their own, so the licence is checked per pack, not per file.
